parsed.answer: This has been requested before in terminal#1939 (UI styling to clearly indicate an elevated window). That ticket proposes a separate background colour, image or title bar styling when the window runs elevated. One commenter also suggested an `adminColorScheme` setting, which is close to your 'defaults for elevated window' idea. The part of the ticket I could see shows no shipped setting for this, so please add your use case and a +1 there. In the meantime, you can make elevated sessions stand out from inside the shell. Add an admin check to your PowerShell prompt or set the window title to '[ADMIN]' when elevated, as commenters in that ticket did. Keep your elevated profile with its own colorScheme and startingDirectory, as you already do. The Terminal team also said colour alone is not enough for accessibility, so a shield icon or similar non-colour indicator is likely to be part of any design.
